AgentInfo.description: The agent (tool, model, session) behind a record.

model.description: The model id, when the source knows it.

session.description: The agent session id, used to group work and to match captures.

BlobId.description: Full git object id (SHA-1 or SHA-256), lowercase hex.

Change.description: The changes a record made to one file.

after_blob.description: Blob of the file right after the change; absent when the change deleted the file.

CommitId.description: Full git object id (SHA-1 or SHA-256), lowercase hex.

Hunk.description:
One changed region of a file, with unified-diff (`git diff -U0`) semantics.

`old_*` refers to the file before the change, `new_*` to the file after it. Lines are
1-based. A pure insertion has `old_lines == 0` and `old_start` is the line it was
inserted after; a pure deletion has `new_lines == 0` and `new_start` is the line after
which the removed lines used to be. Either start may be `0` for a change at the very
top of the file.

RepoPath.description: Path relative to the repository root, '/' separated, no '..' segments.

description: A raw change observed by an editor hook, with no reasoning (ADR 0007).

tool_name.description: The editor tool that made the change, e.g. `Edit` or `Write`.
